contemporary_pakistani.name: Contemporary Pakistani
contemporary_pakistani.description: Modern Pakistani residential villa architecture with travertine stucco, natural teak louvers, charcoal slate feature pier, and expansive curtain glass

modern_minimal.name: Modern Minimal
modern_minimal.description: Clean minimalist high-contrast design with monolithic pure off-white stucco, obsidian cladding, black aluminum, and floor-to-ceiling glass

classical.name: Classical
classical.description: Colonial Pakistani classical manor style with warm limestone plaster, rusticated quoins, architectural cornices, and warm timber accents

mughal_inspired.name: Mughal Inspired
mughal_inspired.description: Heritage-inspired Pakistani architecture with red sandstone hues, Makrana marble accents, intricate geometric jali screens, and dome finials
